task.title: Resolve schedule provenance by task identity
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/807 with fail-closed reverse lookup from one exact task to its materialized schedule.
acceptance_criteria: Return the complete materialized schedule bound to one exact task identity after reopen.
Return no schedule for an unrelated task without mutating either lifecycle.
Fail closed on malformed schedule history and duplicate corrupted task bindings.
Keep provenance inspection separate from task outcome, dispatch, retry, and lifecycle synchronization.

attempts.diagnostic: The integration test failed to compile because find_by_task_id and AmbiguousTaskBinding did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added exact reopen lookup, unrelated-task, malformed-history, and duplicate-binding corruption tests.

attempts.diagnostic: Forward schedule-to-task binding was inspectable only when callers retained the schedule ID, and choosing one duplicate corrupted binding would hide ambiguity.
attempts.patch: Reused authoritative discovery, selected exact materialized task bindings, returned none for zero matches, and emitted typed ambiguity for multiple matches.

attempts.summary: Reviewed diagnostic enrichment without broadening the contract.
attempts.diagnostic: Hosted review suggested including every conflicting schedule ID rather than the exact task identity and conflict count already required by the accepted issue contract.
attempts.patch: Retained the bounded typed ambiguity contract, documented its read-only authority limits, and passed focused tests, docs, full verification, and exact-head quality checks.

outcome.summary: Callers can now resolve exact schedule provenance from a task identity while malformed or ambiguous persisted bindings fail closed.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test --locked -p vela-kernel --test schedule_store

lessons: Add reverse provenance only after the forward binding is durable and validated.
Never choose an arbitrary aggregate when corrupted state produces multiple exact ownership matches.
Reuse one read snapshot so reverse lookup cannot mix schedule revisions.
Diagnostic enrichment beyond the accepted typed contract can remain deferred when it is not needed for correctness or safe recovery.
